stem: Why did Progressive Era reformers support the goal illustrated in this 1874 political cartoon?

options.label: A
options.text: They believed government taxes on the alcohol industry were too high.

options.label: B
options.text: They believed alcohol abuse was an underlying cause of society’s problems.

options.label: C
options.text: They believed the government needed to break up monopolies in the alcohol industry.

options.label: D
options.text: They believed alcohol use should be limited to patriotic celebrations.

visual_elements: Woman on horse with shield and sword attacking barrels labeled BEER, WHISKY, GIN, RUM, BRANDY; banners labeled In the Name of God and Humanity, Temperance League, Wine & Liquors; Title: Woman’s Holy War – Grand Charge on the Enemy’s Works
